description: On the table in front, there’s a white cup near the center and a small white lamp-like stand with a round bulb head farther back against a red backdrop. The left hand stays resting on the left side while the right hand reaches in, grips the cup as a right-hand object, lifts it up and forward toward the stand, then lowers and seats the cup over the bulb/holder area as part of assembling the lamp piece, keeping hold as it settles into place.
